{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan]]

This surprisingly delicious '''chocolate mousse''' [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] is easily made from three New World plants, namely [[Cookbook:Avocado|avocado]], [[Cookbook:Cocoa|cocoa]] and agave.

The avocados should be ''very'' ripe, to the point where the navel almost - or even just - starts to mold.

==Ingredients==

* [[Cookbook:Avocado|Avocado(s)]]
* [[Cookbook:Cocoa|Cocoa powder]]
* [[Cookbook:Agave Syrup|Agave syrup]]

==Procedure==

#Peel the avocados and remove the pit.
#Break down the fleshy parts of the avocados using a [[Cookbook:Fork|fork]] or [[Cookbook:Mixer|mixer]]; depending on the desired texture.
#Add the cocoa powder and [[Cookbook:Mixing|mix]].
#Add agave syrup to taste, and mix some more.
#Serve.
